edges.reason: _msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender, which is the basis of ownership authorization
Ownable constructor assigns the return of _msgSender() to msgSender
Constructor stores msgSender into the _owner state variable
newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership
_setOwner writes the new owner into the _owner state variable
_setOwner reads the current _owner into the oldOwner local variable
newaddr parameter is consumed by changeAddress
changeAddress writes newaddr into the addr state variable
_addr parameter is consumed by the Receiver constructor
Receiver constructor stores _addr into the addr state variable
receive() assigns msg.value to the amount local variable
amount (derived from msg.value) is the value passed to the transfer call
addr state variable is the destination of the external transfer call
receive() performs an external value transfer to addr that could invoke code on the destination
changeAddress mutates the addr state variable used as the transfer target

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter exists only as input to transferOwnership and should be folded into that function node
The newaddr parameter is only meaningful as the argument of changeAddress and should be merged into it
The _addr parameter is used solely to initialize addr in the Receiver constructor and should be merged into that function
The amount local variable is the value passed to the unsafe addr.transfer call and should be folded into that unsafe operation
oldOwner is a temporary cache of _owner inside _setOwner and should be merged into that function
msgSender merely caches the value returned by _msgSender() during construction and should be merged into that function
